sql.where:
deleted = 0
AND type = #{q.type}
AND (goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND record_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startTime}, ' 00:00:00')
AND record_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')

mapper.select:
SELECT id, type, goods_name, goods_num, stock_remain, record_time, operator, remark, create_time FROM warehouse_record
ORDER BY record_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, type, goods_name, goods_num, stock_remain, record_time, operator, remark, create_time FROM warehouse_record
ORDER BY record_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalInNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalOutNum, COUNT(DISTINCT goods_name) AS goodsKinds, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN goods_num ELSE -goods_num END), 0) AS totalStock FROM warehouse_record WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outNum FROM warehouse_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND record_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT goods_name AS goodsName, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS inNum, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN goods_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS outNum, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN goods_num ELSE -goods_num END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS stock, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(record_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastTime FROM warehouse_record
deleted = 0
AND goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY goods_name ORDER BY stock DESC, goods_name ASC
SELECT DISTINCT goods_name FROM warehouse_record WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY goods_name ASC

SELECT id, type, goods_name, goods_num, stock_remain, record_time, operator, remark, create_time, delete_time FROM warehouse_record WHERE deleted = 1
AND (goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY delete_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse_record SET deleted = 1, delete_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE warehouse_record SET deleted = 0, delete_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM warehouse_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
